registered: 2026-10-29, before any phase-2 (fiscal rule) solve; maintainer amendment after the phase-1 review
rule: No threshold, tolerance or design entry may be changed after seeing results. A failed prediction is reported as found.

calibration.note: illustrative, public sovereign parameters otherwise, not fitted

units: debt and thresholds in mean output per quarter (mean y = 1); annual-GDP ratios are a quarter of these

grid.label: COARSE 401 x 21 grid: rules are compared only within this one grid; coarse moments differ from converged ones (e.g. spread SD)

design.start: zero debt, income node n_y // 2, common random numbers across rules

definitions.binding_share_pct: 100 * share of repayment periods (after burn) on the NO-RULE model's paths in which the unconstrained choice violates the rule: b' > cap + 1e-12 (ceiling), b' - b > limit + 1e-12 (deficit)
definitions.binding_in_booms: share of those binding periods with y > 1 (above mean output)
definitions.max_b_recession: max over repayment states with y < 0.92 of the no-rule policy b'(b, y), over states visited on the no-rule paths after burn
definitions.penalty_output_equivalent: penalty / (psi * g^-gamma_g) averaged over repayment periods of the soft_ceiling model's paths: quarterly output needed to offset the penalty at the marginal utility of spending
definitions.escape_vs_ceiling: paired-seed change ceiling_escape - ceiling of each moment; |mean| + 95% Student-t half-width <= tolerance

predictions.escape_inert: max_b_recession about 0.001, far below the 0.02 cap at both cross-check grids; ceiling_escape within tolerance of ceiling on every moment (lenders' prices bind before the rule in recessions)
predictions.penalty_output_equivalent: about 0.002 of quarterly output (0.05 utils at psi v'(g) = g^-2 ~ 25, g ~ 0.2)
